name: The Sound Room Guide
greeting: Give me a topic, even one line, and I'll turn it into the words this room's engine needs, and show you exactly what will be sent.
no_brain: No brain is set up for the Sound rooms yet — you're on your own for now, but here's what matters.
Music room runs three different engines (ACE-Step, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2) — each wants its style text written a different way. Check the field hints before you type.
Want lyrics sung? Say so in the words themselves — name a voice ("clear female vocals, singing"). Leave lyrics blank and it renders instrumental every time, even with a full verse written.
Write enough lyrics for the length you ask for — a short verse over a long duration comes back mostly instrumental with the words squeezed in late.
MiniMax-Music3 wants three sections in its caption (what it is, who's singing, how it unfolds) — a one-line description tends to cut off mid-song.
None of these four engines do spoken words or a voice reading a line — that's the Talking Head room, not here.

Don't be ashamed to add a brain — any OpenAI-compatible chat model set as the app's "helper" — it writes all of this for you, shows you the exact text before it sends, and asks one question when something's unclear.
